services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: The Discovery Center is the perfect place for your family to celebrate a birthday party, baby shower, family reunion, graduation, and more! Our Museum and Story Garden offer a unique and fun place to host your friends, family, or business colleagues. Please Note: Dates and times are subject to availability. A non-refundable deposit of $100 is required to reserve the Museum or Story Garden. The remaining balance is due one week before the date of the party. If the rental is cancelled with 48 hours notice, a refund will be given in the form of another rental to be used within one year. Families will need an active Discovery Center membership in order to register. Full summer registration for our play-based camps opens at 9AM on March 16 2026. Your child will spend sunny days learning and playing in our award-winning Story Garden and taking hikes on the trails within Ross Park. services.name: Field Trips & Groups
services.desc: Discovery Kids Preschool partners with the Binghamton City School District to offer a full-day Universal Pre-Kindergarten Program. Children 4 years of age (by December 1) and residing within the City of Binghamton are eligible for tuition free enrollment in the UPK program. Discovery Kids UPK program is offered for full-day enrollment (8:30AM - 2:45PM), Monday through Friday. UPK follows a kindergarten readiness curriculum supplied by the Binghamton City School District and the State of New York. Enrollment for children residing in the City of Binghamton is limited.
